entry.title: New: Resolution 589 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE LOʻI COLLECTIVE FOUNDATION FOR EXPENSES RELATING TO ITS ANNUAL KANU VOLLEYBALL CLASSIC AT THE WAIMEA DISTRICT PARK

Transfers $3,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 9)

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 589-24 - 8/21/2024
